A.name: A
A.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.loop.fail_kind'] AS fail_kind, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'loop.fail' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, fail_kind ORDER BY ts

annotations.summary: More than 3 loop.fail spans in 5 minutes
annotations.description: Open the Loops dashboard (loop.fail by kind), then the Journeys dashboard with the loop id.
